# Data Source: stripe_payment_method_domain

A domain on which payment methods such as Apple Pay and Google Pay are offered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_payment_method_domain" "checkout" {
  id = stripe_payment_method_domain.checkout.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the payment method domain to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `amazon_pay` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`amazon_pay`](#amazon_pay) below.
* `apple_pay` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`apple_pay`](#apple_pay) below.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `domain_name` - The domain name that this payment method domain object represents.
* `enabled` - Whether this payment method domain is enabled. If the domain is not enabled, payment methods that require a payment method domain will not appear in Elements or Embedded Checkout.
* `google_pay` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`google_pay`](#google_pay) below.
* `klarna` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`klarna`](#klarna) below.
* `link` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`link`](#link) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `paypal` - Indicates the status of a specific payment method on a payment method domain. See [`paypal`](#paypal) below.

<a id="amazon_pay"></a>
### `amazon_pay`

The `amazon_pay` attribute supports:

* `status` - The status of the payment method on the domain. Possible values: `active`, `inactive`.
* `status_details` - Contains additional details about the status of a payment method for a specific payment method domain. See [`amazon_pay.status_details`](#amazon_pay.status_details) below.

<a id="amazon_pay.status_details"></a>
### `amazon_pay.status_details`

The `amazon_pay.status_details` attribute supports:

* `error_message` - The error message associated with the status of the payment method on the domain.
